scientific_integrity: A feasible rooted binary genealogy and an algebraically exact two-to-one parameter alias are displayed, with a separate one-observation identification proof and a standard-library checker. Exact inference requires ideal conditional probability laws; finite checks supplement, not replace, the analytic proof.
scientific_limitations: The statements concern selected conditional Binomial offspring likelihoods for known depth-three genealogy, not the marginal law of unobserved full histories or finite-sample estimator performance. The four-condition design repairs structural, not practical, identifiability. No claim to priority over unindexed nonlinear-design literature is made.
title: An exact two-fold genealogy-decay alias and its one-sample identification repair
